// P4 fixture corpus — property descriptor (vpMV / vpZMV) format rules.
//
// Fix P4: tryVariableEntity handles vpMV / vpZMV with module-aware format:
//   • module == "Foundation"  → full: Module.Type.prop : TypeStr
//   • all other modules       → simplified: TypeName.prop (no module, no type)
//   static properties (Z marker) emit "property descriptor for static ..."
//
// All expected outputs verified against Apple swift-demangle 6.3.

// ── Dispatch: simplified format ───────────────────────────────────────────────

$s8Dispatch0A13TimeoutResultO9hashValueSivpMV ---> property descriptor for DispatchTimeoutResult.hashValue

$s8Dispatch0A13WorkItemFlagsV8rawValueSuvpMV ---> property descriptor for DispatchWorkItemFlags.rawValue

$s8Dispatch0A3QoSV16relativePrioritySivpMV ---> property descriptor for DispatchQoS.relativePriority

$s8Dispatch0A4DataV5countSivpMV ---> property descriptor for DispatchData.count

// ── Combine: simplified format ────────────────────────────────────────────────

$s7Combine0A10IdentifierV11descriptionSSvpMV ---> property descriptor for CombineIdentifier.description

$s7Combine0A10IdentifierV5values6UInt64VvpMV ---> property descriptor for CombineIdentifier.value

$s7Combine0A10IdentifierV9hashValueSivpMV ---> property descriptor for CombineIdentifier.hashValue

// ── SwiftUI: simplified format ────────────────────────────────────────────────

$s7SwiftUI10ButtonRoleV11descriptionSSvpMV ---> property descriptor for ButtonRole.description

// ── SwiftUI: static property descriptor (vpZMV) ───────────────────────────────

$s7SwiftUI10ButtonRoleV5closeACvpZMV ---> property descriptor for static ButtonRole.close

$s7SwiftUI10ButtonRoleV11destructiveACvpZMV ---> property descriptor for static ButtonRole.destructive

// ── Foundation: full format ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

$s10Foundation10CocoaErrorV012isExecutableC0SbvpMV ---> property descriptor for Foundation.CocoaError.isExecutableError : Swift.Bool

$s10Foundation10CocoaErrorV012isFormattingC0SbvpMV ---> property descriptor for Foundation.CocoaError.isFormattingError : Swift.Bool
